key_idea: The string has only 2000 characters, so simulate the match for every k from 1 to n.
sketch: For each k in 1..n scan the string keeping both players' current scores; when one reaches k, credit a game win and reset both to zero. Record k when Alice's wins strictly exceed Bob's. O(n^2) = 4M steps. Pitfalls: the unfinished final game counts for nobody, k larger than n yields zero games so never qualifies, and when the count is zero print only the single line 0.
